context: Ren asks Asuka about graduate school.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: career chat; vocabulary (大学院/医学/書籍/経過/筆者) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大学院に、進もうか迷っています。
lines.en: I'm torn about going to grad school.
lines.style: troubled young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 大学院は、深く学べる場ですよ。
lines.en: Grad school is a place to study deeply.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured encouraging clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 専門の書籍は、難しいですか?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 難しい書籍も、経過とともに読めます。
lines.en: Hard books become readable over time.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医学とは、別の分野でもいいですか?
lines.en: Can it be a field other than medicine?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 医学に限らず、好きな道を選べます。
lines.en: Not just medicine — you can choose any path you love.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いつか、書籍の筆者になりたいです。
lines.en: Someday I want to be a book's author.
lines.style: hopeful young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 筆者になる夢、応援しますよ。
lines.en: I'll support your dream to become an author.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm encouraging closing clarity throughout
